subject.title: feat(plugins): add Control UI entry points

question: Should OpenClaw accept this public plugin Control UI entry-point API and browser launch/session security model before merge?
rationale: The PR creates a new plugin SDK/Gateway/client contract plus token, cookie, and iframe behavior that green unit tests cannot fully settle without maintainer API and security intent.

options.title: Fix blockers, then accept the seam
options.body: Require fail-closed launch handling, a fixed opaque entry-frame sandbox, refreshed exact-head browser proof, and explicit API/security approval before merge.

options.title: Narrow to descriptor-only/RFC work
options.body: Pause this branch and move only the API design or a smaller descriptor seam forward if maintainers want a tighter contract first.

options.title: Close in favor of existing plugin surfaces
options.body: Reject core entry points for now if plugin-owned Control UI should stay in existing descriptors, ClawHub, or owner-specific plugins.

recommendation.title: Fix blockers, then accept the seam
recommendation.body: Require fail-closed launch handling, a fixed opaque entry-frame sandbox, refreshed exact-head browser proof, and explicit API/security approval before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Gateway/plugin/UI history makes this the best available routing owner for API and security-boundary review.
